fields.summary_ko.0: Rothschild's Mike Harrison downgraded Broadcom (AVGO) to 'Neutral' and reduced price target to $398, with AVGO stock down 30% year-to-date and upside potential below 10%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Deepened credit market dependence by Anthropic and OpenAI raises concerns about AI chip customer funding capacity and competition intensification from Google's proprietary AI chip development, evaluated as risk factors to the $230 billion AI revenue forecast for 2028.
